title: Add GPU speed-threshold checks
description:
Add automated or clearly documented manual checks for GPU speed thresholds.

## Background

LDPC BP and BCH syndrome tasks have hard speed criteria, and scheduler work must demonstrate measurable throughput improvement. The checker should be analogous in purpose to `criterion-1.5x` but must support GPU-specific metadata and thresholds.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] LDPC threshold checking can verify at least 3x speedup versus the recorded best production CPU comparator.
- [hard] BCH threshold checking can verify at least 5x speedup versus the recorded best production CPU comparator.
- [hard] Scheduler threshold checking can verify measurable end-to-end throughput improvement versus direct per-thread/default-stream submission.
- [hard] Checker failures are actionable: output names the missing artifact, wrong comparator, insufficient speedup, or unsupported environment.
- [hard] If any check must remain manual because ROCm hardware is not available in default CI, the manual gate procedure and required artifacts are documented.

## Notes

Part of story `dc32270e` and spec `dev/plans/hip_gpu_prototype_wave.md`.
